items.quote: 34:8 And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
items.claim: In the narrative, Moses quickly bowed his head to the ground and worshipped. The text only labels this verse "34:8". Identifying it as Exodus 34:8, set at Sinai, is an unverified model-prior and is not stated in the evidence.
items.action: made haste, bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped
